citation: Thorngren, D. P., Fortney, J. J., Murray-Clay, R. A. and Lopez, E. D. 2016, ApJ 831, 64
note: 47 cool transiting giants: heavy-element mass correlates with planet mass, and Zplanet/Zstar is strongly related to planet mass; many planets hold over 50 Earth masses of heavy elements; DOI matches. Abstract supports the relation, but the fit itself (9.7 ± 1.3, exponent -0.45) is blank in the abstract Consensus holds and was not read. [Chachan et al. 2025](https://consensus.app/papers/details/w:f153ecaf-a777-4615-90ab-a253a24dfa62/?utm_source=claude_desktop) revise it: the ratio flattens near 3.3 at high mass.
